guitar.guitaristsText: Keith Richards / Ronnie Wood / Mick Taylor
guitar.modelsText: Fender Telecaster ('Micawber', 5-string open-G) / Gibson Les Paul / ES series
guitar.evidence: Keith Richards' 5-string open-G-tuned Telecaster 'Micawber' is one of the most famous specific guitars in rock history; this justifies high rather than medium confidence.
guitar.notes: Upgraded confidence from medium to high due to Richards' very specifically documented guitar/tuning setup.

tone.target: dirty open-G rock crunch with raw fuzz bite
tone.profile: dirty open-G rock crunch with raw fuzz bite
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing Fuzz/Distortion into a UK 45 or UK 50 style amp, paired with a vintage cabinet to achieve the dirty, punchy sound of classic Stones rhythm guitar.

rig.name: The Rolling Stones - Jumpin' Jack Flash - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum inherent in high-gain rock tones.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for noisy guitar recordings.

blocks.purpose: Provide a raw, mid-focused boost to push the fuzz and drive into the amp stage.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here as a general dirty booster/preamp substitute for classic rock grit, avoiding the polish of an explicit Tube Screamer model.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core 'fuzzy edge' and raw bite required for the Stones' sound.
blocks.gap: None. Fuzz is essential for this genre/tone.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the sound of a small, punchy British combo amplifier (Plexi/Marshall style).
blocks.gap: None. This model captures the desired 'small combo' feel.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British rock cabinet tone and punchy midrange response.
blocks.gap: None. Standard choice for this genre.

blocks.purpose: Scoop the extreme frequencies and boost the raw midrange punch (the 'raw midrange' requirement).
blocks.gap: While a specific EQ curve might be better, Guitar EQ 2 allows for precise mid-hump shaping.

blocks.purpose: Explicitly disabled as per the 'drop wah' correction and focus on raw rhythm.
blocks.gap: The module is present but deactivated to meet the specific tone requirements.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle sense of space and depth without washing out the raw attack.
blocks.gap: The goal is 'dry and raw,' so reverb must be kept minimal to avoid excessive wash.

improvements.summary: Enhance cabinet realism and punch by swapping the default IR for a vintage British speaker simulation.

proposals.reason: Improve midrange bite and raw punch required for Stones' rhythm tone.
proposals.expectedGain: Punchier, more authentic British rock sound
